## Get started here

**60-second tour:** open **03 - Ecommerce Checkout → 1. Purchase** → **Send** → **Visualize tab** → click **Open payment page →** → pay with a test card below → back here, send **Check Transaction** → APPROVED.

The full guide lives on the collection **Overview** tab (click the collection name). Nothing needs configuring — the public sandbox demo merchant is pre-filled.

This folder: test cards, endpoints reference, and the docs links.

## 60-second walkthrough (zero setup)

1. **03 - Ecommerce Checkout → 1. Purchase (Hosted Checkout)** → **Send**.
2. Open the **Visualize** tab → click **Open payment page →** (form-POSTs the signed fields; the page is served by PayWay itself).
3. Pay with a sandbox test card:

   | Card | Number | Expiry | CVV |
   |---|---|---|---|
   | ✅ Success | `4286 0900 0000 0206` | 04/30 | 777 |
   | ❌ Declined | `5156 8302 7256 1029` | 04/30 | 777 |

4. Back in Postman: **3. Check Transaction** → `payment_status_code: 0 (APPROVED)`.

**What happened automatically:** the hash was signed (`b4hash:` in the Console), the response saved `{{last_tran_id}}`, and the Visualizer rendered the merchant-style launcher.

Next stops: **Flow A** (folder 11) for KHQR + polling, **08** for saved tokens, **10** for callbacks. Full guide: collection **Overview** tab.

### Sandbox cards (values are pre-set as collection variables)

| Result | Type | Card number | Expiry | CVV | 3-D Secure |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Success | Mastercard | `{{test_mc_success}}` (5156 8399 3770 6777) | 01/30 | 993 | No |
| Success | Visa | `{{test_visa_success}}` (4286 0900 0000 0206) | 04/30 | 777 | Yes |
| Declined | Mastercard | `{{test_mc_declined}}` (5156 8302 7256 1029) | 04/30 | 777 | Yes |
| Declined | Visa | `{{test_visa_declined}}` (4156 8399 3770 6777) | 01/30 | 993 | No |

Use these in the hosted checkout page that PayWay opens for the **purchase** flow (folder 03).

### 3-D Secure
Visa cards above trigger a simulated 3DS challenge — enter any code to continue. Mastercard success card has no 3DS.

## What this collection covers
- **Ecommerce Checkout** (folder 03): Purchase, Get TXN Details, Check TXN, Close TXN, Refund, TXN List, Exchange Rate
- **ABA QR API** (folder 04): Generate QR
- **Payment Link** (folder 05): Create, Get Details
- **Pre-auth** (folder 06): Complete, Complete+payout, Cancel
- **Payout** (folder 07): Payout, Add-to-whitelist, Update whitelist status
- **Credentials on File (CoF)** (folder 08): Link-account, Link-card, Get-token-details, Payment, Renew, Remove
- **KHQR Guideline** (folder 09): Get transactions by merchant ref
- **Callbacks & Webhooks** (folder 10): payment/token payloads + verification + senders
- **Polling & Lifecycle Flows** (folder 11): Collection-Runner flows (setNextRequest)
